desc:
Welcome to this game!
Here you can find almost every cutscene or jumpscare ever in doors! (Still working on some stuff...)
This is just a showcase game where you can play around with stuff like Jumpscares and Cutscenes!

Any like / favorite / visit or feedback is truly appreciated! 🙏
Also if you do happen to dislike the game, please leave a feedback why, this is crucial for us to understand what's wrong! 

Recent Update: (9/24/2026) Welcome to the Archives! (2 New Floors + 5 New Scenes + More...) 😏

All credits go to LSPLASH team's Programmers and Modelers.
This game uses a lot of assets from "DOORS" by LSPLASH, no revenue is earned, this experience was made for fun and people to enjoy!

I hope you enjoy it! (Private servers highly recommended!)
(Please note the game is not fully finished it has some bugs, something is missing, if you find one, report it in my community, thank you!)
